Review: the Invented Stand Mixer 500

We tested the invented stand mixer for three weeks in a home kitchen. It has a 5-litre bowl, ten speeds and a dough hook, and it is quieter than most mixers at this price.

Bread dough came together in about six minutes. Whipping cream at the top speed splashed a little, so we suggest the splash guard that comes in the box.

Verdict: a solid mixer for families who bake every week. Four stars out of five.
